parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Phenylamine reacts with $\text{HNO}_2\text{(aq)}$ at $4^{\circ}\text{C}$ to form compound **P**. Compound **P** reacts with phenol under alkaline conditions at $4^{\circ}\text{C}$. The product of this reaction is acidified, forming azo compound **Q**.

Draw the structure of compound **Q**.

Circle the azo group on your structure.

State one use of an azo compound such as **Q**.
